author: marthomahew
name: emotesteal
short: Add emoji and stickers from other servers to this one.
description: Reply to a message with `[p]steal` and the bot adds its custom emoji and stickers to this server. For admins and mods.
install_msg: Loaded? Give the bot the Manage Expressions permission, then reply to a message with `[p]steal`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
